purpose: Determine the numerically preferred H adsorption basin on the accepted relaxed Ru(0001) substrate without using published H/Ru site ordering, barriers, kinetics, chi, or expected downstream agreement as selectors.

substrate_model.electrostatics: ordinary 3D periodic symmetric slab; no ESM and no dipole correction

requirements: exact H pseudopotential identity and SHA-256 recorded
H pseudopotential provenance/transferability qualification completed without using target adsorption or kinetic agreement
same exact H pseudopotential used in every site-screen case
hydrogen_entry_gate.reason: The clean-surface PASS licenses protocol freeze, but H-specific production remains gated on independent pseudopotential qualification.

screen_model.adsorption_symmetry: one H on each face at symmetry-related instances of the same candidate site to preserve a nominally symmetric slab
screen_model.kmesh_basis: density-preserving scaling of the accepted primitive-surface 16x16x1 mesh

stage_A_constrained_screen.H_motion: z_only at the registered high-symmetry x-y site
stage_A_constrained_screen.Ru_motion: outer two Ru layers on each face z_only; interior Ru fixed
stage_A_constrained_screen.purpose: Find the lowest converged vertical basin for each registered site without allowing immediate lateral migration to erase site identity.

stage_B_stability_release.cases: one lowest-energy converged Stage-A geometry per registered site
stage_B_stability_release.Ru_motion: outer two Ru layers on each face z_only; interior Ru fixed
stage_B_stability_release.migration_rule: If a released H migrates into another registered basin, record the starting site as unstable rather than constraining it back or calling it a separate minimum.

numerical_reproduction.rule: For each final candidate minimum retained for ordering, perform a fresh SCF at the frozen final geometry with no restart state inherited from the ionic relaxation.

selection_rule.primary: Rank only reproduced converged minima by total energy per symmetric 2-H supercell under identical settings.
selection_rule.unstable_sites: A site that relaxes laterally into another basin is not retained as a distinct minimum.
selection_rule.near_degeneracy: If the energy separation of retained minima is not larger than the independently established numerical uncertainty, carry all unresolved minima forward; do not force a unique winner.
selection_rule.adsorption_energy_claim: Do not promote a thermodynamic adsorption energy until the isolated-H/H2 reference route and coverage interpretation are separately qualified.
